request: Goal: Implement retry-then-defer for AI review and gate findings in the flow engine. Scope: after configured attempts are exhausted, persist unresolved semantic findings in flow-findings.json and continue traversal; preserve blocking behavior for invalid schemas, missing required artifacts, failed commands, failed tests, tool failures, no-progress guards, and corrupted flow state; extend acceptance-review so it re-evaluates persisted findings, writes final classifications, and selects an allowlisted return step when another round is required. Verification: add focused node/test coverage for defer recording, blocker preservation, acceptance-review routing, and round-limit behavior. Source: GitHub Issue #383.
